In [77]:
def preprocessing(adata, batch):
    sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=2) # need to run this again after separating young/old
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata)
    sc.pp.pca(adata)
#     sce.pp.harmony_integrate(adata, key=batch)
#     sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_pca_harmony')
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata)
    sc.tl.umap(adata)
    return adata
